verdict.rationale:
ClickUp lists Automations as a product and documents triggering workflows from ClickUp events, which covers event-driven routine work. Nothing in the evidence shows schedule-based or recurring triggers, and these are thin one-line mentions. The n8n integration suggests external workflow tooling may be needed for anything beyond basic triggers.
missing for 10: documented schedule/cron or recurring-time triggers, detailed automation docs (triggers, conditions, actions), hands-on or independent corroboration
